en.quote: Given the decline in the trade balance, we estimate the ruble’s average rate for 2023 at 76.5 to the dollar.
en.head: The 2023 average exchange rate exceeded the forecast.
en.body: In April, the ministry forecast an average of 76.5 rubles per dollar for 2023. The Bank of Russia’s annual report records a full-year average nominal rate of 84.66. The figures cover the same annual measure; the initial forecast was too low.

osrc.t: Bank of Russia, 2023 annual report, Table 21
